mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconcile_batch (batch_id, channel, file_name, total_rows, diff_count, imported_by) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{channel}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalRows}, #{diffCount}, #{importedBy})

INSERT INTO reconcile_difference ( batch_id, channel, bill_type, diff_type, bill_trade_no, local_no, local_amount, channel_amount, status ) VALUES ( #{batchId}, #{channel}, #{billType}, #{diffType}, #{billTradeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{localNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{localAmount,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{channelAmount,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reconcile_batch
AND channel = #{channel}

SELECT difference_id, batch_id, channel, bill_type, diff_type, bill_trade_no, local_no, local_amount, channel_amount, status, remark, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at FROM reconcile_difference
ORDER BY difference_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT difference_id, batch_id, channel, bill_type, diff_type, bill_trade_no, local_no, local_amount, channel_amount, status, remark, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_at FROM reconcile_difference WHERE difference_id = #{differenceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reconcile_difference SET status = 'RESOLVED', remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt} WHERE difference_id = #{differenceId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, pay_no, order_id, buyer_id, seller_id, channel, amount, refunded_amount, status, idempotency_key, paid_at, reconciled_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted FROM payment WHERE channel = #{channel} AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUNDED') AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.refund_id, r.payment_id, r.order_id, r.buyer_id, r.seller_id, r.amount, r.reason, r.status, r.channel_refund_no, r.channel_error, r.refunded_at, r.audited_by, r.audit_remark, r.audited_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.created_by, r.updated_by, r.is_deleted FROM refund r JOIN payment p ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id WHERE p.channel = #{channel} AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.is_deleted = 0
